title: DayPage account tag import payload v1
description: Canonical immutable import metadata payload stored in memo_tag_imports.payload. It contains NO note body and NO auth state. Labels keep their original leading '#', Unicode, case, punctuation, and hierarchy exactly as supplied: no normalization, no splitting on comma or slash, and no invented parent labels. The transport-level 8 MiB payload cap is enforced server-side over PostgreSQL jsonb::text and is not expressible in JSON Schema. Per-memo tags may repeat a label token (the raw snapshot keeps duplicates; the database stores one association per distinct (memo_id, label)).

catalog.description: The complete source catalog in source order, including labels unused by any memo. Duplicate entries are rejected.

memos.description: Memo metadata map in source order. Every entry is preserved, including entries with empty tag arrays. Duplicate memo_id values are rejected. UUID equality is case-insensitive; consumers must implement the x-daypage-uniqueProperties semantic keyword accordingly, without rewriting input payloads.

label.description: Exact account tag label: leading '#', non-empty suffix, at most 1024 UTF-8 bytes, no ASCII controls or DEL. U+0000 is also rejected here because jsonb cannot store it.
